layers.note: Carpets the floor of moist, shady conifer forest.

heat_load.note: Favours cool, shaded aspects and ravines; scarce on hot south-west slopes.

elevation_m.note: Sea level to about 1,000 m in western Washington; the upper limits are loose.

shade_tolerance.note: Very shade tolerant: needs forest shade.

sun_tolerance.note: Shade obligate: its leaves fold and scorch in direct sun, and it declines in clearings.

provenance.notes: Authored from general knowledge of the species in the south Puget Sound lowlands; not yet checked against the public-domain USDA references (Silvics of North America, the Fire Effects Information System, PLANTS).
